hooks.name: player_start_spectating_entity
hooks.neoforge: none (NeoForge has no such event; Paper's PlayerStartSpectatingEntityEvent)

rust_summary: a spectator started watching an entity (`native_player_start_spectating_entity`).
doc_summary: `native_player_start_spectating_entity(player, name, entity_id, kind)`: a spectator's camera was set to an entity of type `kind`, the start that `native_player_stop_spectating_entity` ends. Bundles need "hooks": @API:player_start_spectating_entity@.
